note: This is the contrib drupal/ban module (machine name 'ban'), the continuation of former core Ban. Banned IPs live in the ban_ip DB table and are managed by the ban.ip_manager service (BanIpManager: banIp/unbanIp/isBanned/findAll/findById/unbanAllIps); enforced by ban.middleware (403). Admin UI at /admin/config/people/ban (route ban.admin_page, permission 'ban IP addresses'); single IPv4/IPv6 only, no subnet ranges in the ban list. Allowlist is settings.php only: $settings['ban_allowlist'] (IPs or CIDR). CLI commands ban:ban/ban:unban/ban:list/ban:flush are Symfony Console commands. No config object. Medium/hard use documentation IPs (RFC 5737 TEST-NET) via ban.ip_manager: medium reads back a banned IP, hard bans a target IP and verifies isBanned.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site using the contrib Ban module, where do I ban an IP address in the UI, and how do I make sure a trusted IP or subnet can never be banned?
evals.expected_output: Ban an IP at Configuration > People > IP address bans (/admin/config/people/ban). To protect trusted addresses define $settings['ban_allowlist'] in settings.php (single IPs or CIDR subnet ranges, IPv4/IPv6) - allowlisted addresses can never be banned.

evals.prompt: Which command-line commands does the Ban module provide to ban, unban, list, and clear banned IP addresses?
evals.expected_output: ban:ban <ip>, ban:unban <ip>, ban:list, and ban:flush - Symfony Console commands runnable via the Drupal CLI (dr) or Drush.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal Ban module, which service do I use to ban an IP or check if one is banned from custom code, and where are banned IPs stored?
evals.expected_output: Use the ban.ip_manager service (BanIpManager): banIp(), unbanIp(), isBanned(), findAll(), unbanAllIps(). Banned IPs are stored in the ban_ip database table.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, exactly one IP address is currently banned via the Ban module. Inspect the live ban list and give that IP address.
evals.expected_output: The banned IP is 203.0.113.77 (e.g. drush ban:list, or \Drupal::service('ban.ip_manager')->findAll(), or SELECT ip FROM ban_ip).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use the Ban module to ban the IP address 198.51.100.42 so that visits from it would be blocked. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: 198.51.100.42 is added to the ban list so ban.ip_manager isBanned() returns TRUE (e.g. `drush ban:ban 198.51.100.42`, or the 'Ban IP address' form at /admin/config/people/ban, or \Drupal::service('ban.ip_manager')->banIp('198.51.100.42')).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Ban module has one IP address on its ban list. Inspect the live ban list and give that IP address.
evals.expected_output: The banned IP is 192.0.2.55 (drush ban:list, ban.ip_manager->findAll(), or SELECT ip FROM ban_ip).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Ban module currently has the IP address 192.0.2.99 on its ban list. Remove the ban on 192.0.2.99 so that address is no longer blocked. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: 192.0.2.99 is removed from the ban list so ban.ip_manager isBanned() returns FALSE (e.g. `drush ban:unban 192.0.2.99`, the 'Unban' action at /admin/config/people/ban, or \Drupal::service('ban.ip_manager')->unbanIp('192.0.2.99')).
